data.raw_text:
[3:38PM] #VI #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement from McWen Bridge inward Bonny Camp Roundabout is currently flowing smoothly. Similarly, the route inward Ahmadu Bello Way is largely free, with only a slight delay observed at the Adeola Odeku junction due to ongoing alternation delays. The return journey back to Bonny Camp also remains relatively clear.

Vehicular flow along Adetokunbo Ademola, heading toward the Eko Hotel Roundabout, is steady. However, traffic is beginning to build up near the roundabout due to the closing hour rush and traffic alternations at that point. Movement from Eko Hotel toward Sanusi Fafunwa is steady and progressing.

From Bonny Camp underbridge enroute Kofo Abayomi, vehicular movement is good. Kofo Abayomi inbound to Oniru is busy but moving, affected by the closing hour rush and traffic alternations.

Traffic from the Law School axis enroute Civic Centre is experiencing a high influx of vehicles but remains in motion. From Civic Centre toward BJ1004, there is a steady flow of vehicles around the BJ1004 area. Once past BJ1004, traffic improves considerably along the route to School Corner, Sandfield, and into Lekki Phase 1.

The return journey from Lekki through Sandfield, connecting School Corner, is smooth. BJ1004 inbound Civic Centre experiences moving traffic.

Traffic from Civic Centre to the Ramp bridge is gradually building up, while the movement toward Law School connecting Akin Adesola is encouraging. Akin Adesola toward Kilimanjaro is also experiencing steady traffic flow.

Movement from Kilimanjaro to Kofo and onward to Bonny Camp Roundabout is slightly busy but remains in motion, with some delays due to road alternation works underneath Bonny Camp Bridge.

Overall, only slight traffic delays are being experienced at known alternation points, and no impediments have been sighted at this time.

#FollowLASTMA

However, traffic flow improves significantly beyond the Offin Canal market towards Ijora Olopa by the NEPA intersection.

Broad Street to Apongbon, under the bridge connecting to Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo, reports steady movement. Eko Bridge inbound to Apongbon, connecting to CMS, has good traffic flow. Additionally, descending Carter Bridge inward to Ebute-Ero, through Leventis and the UBA roundabout towards the inner and outer Marina, is also clear.

Currently, no impediments are reported, and personnel are visibly present, managing the situation.

#FollowLASTMA
